name: Bagan
about: Cool-dry season Nov–Feb is best (and prime for sunrise balloon rides), hot Mar–May, monsoon Jun–Oct.
overview: Thousands of ancient Buddhist temples scattered across a dusty plain, best explored slowly by e-bike at sunrise and sunset.
costOverview: Tea, food, and e-bike rental are all cheap — the archaeological zone pass is the one real fixed cost, valid across your whole stay.

specialSeasons.text: Calm, dry conditions make this the best window for sunrise hot-air balloon flights over the temple plain.
